deadline.value: Constant intake with no set deadline; finish your application at least 4 months before the start date, especially as an international student.
deadline.quote: Application deadline: There is a constant intake with no set deadline. | It is recommended that the application be completed at least 4 months ahead of the desired admission cycle, especially for international students.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required or considered.
gre_general.quote: A GRE is not required or considered.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT overall 4.5 (out of 6) with Writing 5, Speaking 4, Reading 4.5, Listening 4.5.

supervisor.value: Contact potential supervisors before applying; this does not guarantee acceptance.
supervisor.quote: We encourage you to identify an area of research interest and contact potential supervisor(s) before applying. | Please note, however, that contacting a faculty member does not guarantee acceptance and you will need to submit your full application in order to be considered.

funding.value: The PhD is fully funded for four years.

entry_route.value: PhD normally follows a master's, but BSc holders can be admitted directly (with more coursework); B+ average required.
entry_route.quote: Students in the MSc program who are promoted to the PhD program, as well as BSc holders that are admitted directly to the PhD program are required to take a minimum of four term courses. | The Department of Chemical Engineering requires a B+ average or equivalent for admission to all graduate programs.

notes: Starts in September, January or May.
